name: Kahn
summary: The company secretary, identified by Larry at right in VN-0003. Larry remembers that he "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio." On 2026-09-12 Larry called him "the company clerk, morning report written by him," placed him at right in VN-0003 and VN-0008 with Ron Tototz beside him, and said of VN-0007, where Kahn is absent, "Kahn must be taking the picture."
researchNotes: As company secretary he would appear throughout the unit's paperwork, making him a good anchor name for locating the unit's morning reports at NPRC once the unit itself is confirmed. The spelling is phonetic; Kahn, Khan, Conn, and Kohn are all candidates. 2026-08-23 (giscus-stories-c18118728): "Khan wrote the morning reports for the Unit." This makes Kahn directly relevant to the morning-reports request (issue #27): if those reports are obtained, his name should appear on them as the clerk who typed them, which would both corroborate this account and confirm the unit. 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0003-c18415619, -vn-0007-c18415627, -vn-0008-c18415632): "company clerk" is Larry's word this time where 2026-08-13 has "company secretary"; the two are the same job, and the role field now uses his later word. The morning-report detail is repeated unprompted, three weeks after it was first given (2026-08-23), which strengthens it as memory, though not as fact. "Kahn must be taking the picture" is Larry reasoning from who is missing, not a memory of Kahn holding the camera.
